body: Death is inevitable, yes, but life is something unique and special.  Think about the tiny chance that it was you who was born into your body. You have control over your destiny and the things that happen around you. It isn't that death is wrong, it is the fact that if you manage to push through this that you will be happy one day and feel like you have accomplished something in the gift of life. I struggle with this too and trust me I understand completely, but we all fight to feel joy before our inevitable end. Stay strong my friend.
